title: Arsenal sign defender Ezri Konsa for £55 million
subtitle: English defender leaves Aston Villa to bolster the Arsenal squad in the transfer window.
excerpt: Arsenal have completed the signing of English defender Ezri Konsa from Aston Villa in a £55 million deal.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Arsenal have announced the completion of the signing of English defender Ezri Konsa. The player arrives at the club after leaving Aston Villa in a transfer valued at £55 million.

The deal marks a club move for the England international, who has shown a strong desire to succeed with his new team, as highlighted by the club and his proactive stance in the transfer market.

With the £55 million agreement finalized, Arsenal strengthen their defensive line with the addition of Konsa for the remainder of the competitions.

With information from BBC Sport.
